All core features working: Homepage with hero carousel (Swiper.js), bottom navigation, auth modal for protected routes, login/register flow, Store page with coin packages, Profile page, Series detail page with episode list, Creator Login page, Admin Login page. Fixed critical bug: Store page not showing coin packages due to API response format mismatch and missing geo endpoints.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend refactoring complete and tested. All routes working: /, /series/:id, /store, /profile, /creator, /creator/login, /admin, /admin/login. Store page required fix for API response format (packages array nested in object). Geo endpoints were missing and added to payments.py. Promo popup appears on first visit - close with data-testid='promo-close-btn'.

bugs_fixed.issue: Store page not showing coin packages
bugs_fixed.root_cause: 1) Frontend expected packagesRes.data to be array but API returns {packages: [...]}. 2) Missing /geo/detect and /geo/countries endpoints causing Promise.all to fail
bugs_fixed.fix_applied: 1) Changed setPackages(packagesRes.data) to setPackages(packagesRes.data.packages || packagesRes.data). 2) Added /geo/detect and /geo/countries endpoints to payments.py
